apps.name: ARMSX2
apps.subtitle: PlayStation 2 emulator for ARM64
apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk, sideload it
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it

## What's new
- iOS: drop the FFmpeg license entry, which no longer ships
- iOS: drop the OSD capture writes the video capture removal left behind
- eerunner: pass the FPU mask through to ParseGroups
- GS: remove video capture, and with it the ffmpeg dependency
- Touch controls: don't auto-hide while the pad is being used
- LSFG: rebuild the swap chain when frame generation turns on later
- Quick loading: warn about the space first, and allow removing it after
- Quick loading: four fixes found by actually running it on the disc
- Quick loading: stop making the user rename the ELF
- GS: don't build video capture on Android
- Outbreak quick loading: make the host: ELF method work on Android
- Update SettingsRootView.swift for stosdebug
- Update EmulatorSettingsView.swift for stosdebug
- Update EmulatorBridge.swift for StosDebug
- Qt: Update EE and VU recompiler setting descriptions
- Qt: Add missing setting descriptions
- GameDB: Port SCPS-15064's patch to SCKA-20027
- Library: rename and delete categories
- FullscreenUI: Align setting descriptions with Qt
- Qt: Update EE and VU recompiler setting descriptions
- Qt: Add missing setting descriptions
- Library: custom game categories
- Deps: Bump `ffmpeg` to 9.0.1
- Deps: Set minimum required ffmpeg version to 7.1
- Deps: Get rid of the in-tree ffmpeg headers entirely
- Deps: Dont hardcode the ffmpeg dlls path
- GSCapture: Switch the use of `pix_fmts` with `avcodec_get_supported_config()`
- PAD: Update to latest controller database.
- VU: fix typo in a constant
- SW: Fix C rasterizor IIP vector pack (signed->unsigned)
- GameDB: Fix Japanese Title&Sort
- GameDB: Port SCPS-15064's patch to SCKA-20027
- In-game settings: write the per-game INI before the commit, not after
- Skins: name the creator on each row in the browser
- GS:MTL: Add workaround for Apple GPU hardware bug
- translations: Syncing Crowdin translations (#14879)
- Credit misantronic in code for PRs #616 and #617
- Let a companion app request recent-games access per caller
- Android: turn hardcore off while a RetroAchievements host override is active
- Affinity: pick performance cores by capacity, and make that the default
- Save states: show when each slot was written, not its filename
- Slot dates: ask the running VM, not the filename matcher
- Launch Game: a menu entry for the picker that was already there
- Per-slot save/load hotkeys, and dates on the in-game slot picker
- Fix rumble on external pads, macro dialog in landscape, hotkey pop-up discoverability
- SGSR: adopt the revised upstream maths for the plain variant
- PAD: Update to latest controller database.
- Translations: Sync Crowdin translations for 2.8
- SPU2: Pass IOP cycle count at 64bit
- Qt: Update Base Translation.
- Qt/macOS: Keep Fullscreen on the main window
- GameDB: Add Prioritize Lower depth fix to Steambot Chronicles
- GS/HW: Avoid detecting shuffles as source of truth for target format
- GS/TC: Improve single pixel overlap detection in RT in RT
- EE/IOP: Fix loading elf's through relative path

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20260830...6e1e8f0a18f2f5bbcd2e75344d89ff6ba03b5616
